scope: m=4 only. Exact evaluation/field-map and canonical polynomial semantics, no finite-field interpolation. Does not prove all-m recursion/degree, irreducibility, solving degree, regularity or attack complexity. Unsigned producer standing.
statement: For a general Weierstrass model over any field, the actual S4 polynomial has symbolic degree4 in every one of its four input positions, represented by canonical iterated-polynomial Sylvester determinants with the other inputs formal. After specialization, each degree is at most4 and equals4 exactly when S3 on the other three coordinates is nonzero; the fourth coefficient is S3 squared. On the actual smooth F5 curve y^2=x^3-x, S4(0,1,4,T) is the nonzero constant1 of degree0, disproving universal preservation of degree under specialization.
